name: Radical-Level Oracle Bone Character Recognition
description: The dataset is about radical-level oracle bone character recognition. It contains images of oracle bone characters paired with a short instruction to recognize the character, and the corresponding modern Chinese character as the answer. It evaluates visual recognition of ancient Chinese script.
card_text: This dataset supports radical-level oracle bone character recognition from images. Each sample includes a bitmap image (input.image_file) of a single oracle bone character, a natural-language instruction (input.prompt) such as 'Recognize the oracle bone character in the image.', and the target character as a short text answer (output.text). The images are simple, focused glyphs rather than complex scenes, and the text prompt is short and instructional. The dataset has 220 samples and is open-set with respect to character classes, covering various oracle bone script forms. It tests a model's ability to visually identify ancient Chinese characters and output the corresponding modern character. No additional context or multiple-choice options are provided.

image.semantics: Bitmap image file containing a single radical-level oracle bone character to be recognized. It is the primary visual input for the recognition task.

question.semantics: Short natural-language instruction directing the model to recognize the oracle bone character shown in the accompanying image.

answer.semantics: The recognized character as a modern Chinese character string, which is the target answer corresponding to the oracle bone script depicted in the image.

meta.meta_structure_description: Each sample consists of a single oracle bone character image (input.image_file), a short natural-language instruction (input.prompt) asking to recognize the character in the image, and the target modern Chinese character as text (output.text). The instruction references the image as the object to recognize, and the answer is the recognition result.
